_comment: Phase-4 write-execution guardrails. All spend numbers in ACCOUNT CURRENCY (USD). Executor is dry-run unless run with --live AND kill_switch is off.
_kill_switch_note: Set true (or export FB_ENGINE_KILL_SWITCH=1) to block ALL live writes even under --live. Dry-run still shows what it would do.
_no_scale_after_note: Fulfillment/seasonal cut-off (methodology Part 8): 'YYYY-MM-DD' after which SCALE actions are skipped, so you don't scale spend into a window your POD supplier can't ship in time (refund risk). null = no limit. Kills/pauses still run.
